definitions.explanation: A freestanding portable ladder that opens into an A-frame shape, used for reaching high places.

examples.japanese: {脚立|きゃたつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stood on a stepladder to change the light bulb.

examples.japanese: {脚立|きゃたつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Open the stepladder and set it up.

examples.japanese: {脚立|きゃたつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちない→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Be careful not to fall off the stepladder.

notes:
{脚立|きゃたつ} refers to a stepladder, a self-supporting ladder that does not need to lean against a wall.
